messages.subject: עזרה בGGPLOT בSHINY
parts:
hi,
im trying to add a ggplot bar chart on shiny with reactive objects, my dataset and I keep getting error messages, I would appretiate your help:
here it is the script


server: 

library(shiny)
library(datasets)
library(ggplot2)

shinyServer(function(input, output, clientData, session) {

  filterx <- reactive({
    
    t <- survey
    t[, c(input$x)]
  })
  
  filtery <- reactive({
    
    t <- survey
    t[, c(input$y)]
  })
  
  datasetInput <- reactive({
    xfiltervalue <- input$xvalue
    yfiltervalue <- input$yvalue
    filterX <- filterx()
    filterY <- filtery()
    
     subset(survey, filterX<=xfiltervalue & filterY<=yfiltervalue )
      })
  
  selectedData <- reactive({
    
    z <- datasetInput()
    z[, c(input$x, input$y)]
  })
  
  
  selectedx <- reactive({
    
    z <- datasetInput()
    z[, c(input$x)]
  })
  
  selectedy <- reactive({
    z <- datasetInput()
    z[, c(input$y)]
  })
  

  output$summary <- renderPrint({
    summary (selectedData())
  })
  
  
  # Show the first "n" observations
  output$mytable2 = renderDataTable({
    head(datasetInput(), n = input$N)
  })
  
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    c <- ggplot(datasetInput(), aes_string(x=input$x, y=input$y))
    p <-c + geom_bar()
   print(p)
  })
  
  output$barchart1 <- renderPlot({
    y <- selectedy()
    x <- table( y, selectedx() )
    barplot(x, main="Distribution of X by Y", 
            xlab=" ", 
            col=c("dark blue","light green"), legend = rownames(x), beside=TRUE)
  })
  
  output$barchart2 <- renderPlot({
    y <- selectedx()
    x <- table( y, selectedy() )
    barplot(x, main="Distribution of Y by X", 
            xlab="xx ", 
           legend = rownames(x))
  })
  output$histx <- renderPlot({
    
    hist(selectedx(), main="HISTOGRAM X",xlab="X" ,freq=FALSE, col=c("dark blue") )
  })
  output$histy <- renderPlot({
    
    hist(selectedy(),main="HISTOGRAM Y",xlab="Y",freq=FALSE, col=c("light green") )
  })
 
})





uR:
library(shiny)

dataset <-survey48


shinyUI(fluidPage(
  titlePanel("ניתוח סקרים"),
  

  sidebarLayout(
    sidebarPanel(
      
      selectInput('x', 'X', names(dataset)),
     selectInput('y', 'Y', names(dataset), names(dataset)[[2]]),
     sliderInput("xvalue",
                 "This controls X values:",
                 min = 1, max = 99, value = 10),
     sliderInput("yvalue",
                 "This controls Y values:",
                 min = 1, max = 99, value = 10),
      numericInput("N", "Number of observations to view:", 100)
    ),
    
    mainPanel(
      plotOutput('plot'),
      verbatimTextOutput("summary"),
      plotOutput('histx'),
      plotOutput('histy'),
      plotOutput("barchart1"),
      plotOutput("barchart2"),
      dataTableOutput("mytable2")
    )
  )
))




thank you
elian!
